Eyewitness identification.requires: a witness who saw the event
Eyewitness identification.provides: direct testimony, vulnerability to challenge on reliability

Forensic DNA match.requires: a recovered sample and a reference profile
Forensic DNA match.provides: a statistical match figure, no account of how the sample arrived

Digital device records.requires: a seized device and lawful access to it
Digital device records.provides: timestamps and locations, dependence on attributing the device to a person

No evidence recovered at all.requires: a scene and an investigation yielding nothing
No evidence recovered at all.provides: no forensic link of any kind, no material to put before a court

Denial of presence.provides: a claim of being elsewhere, no dispute about the act itself

Admission with lawful excuse.provides: a claim of self-defence or consent, no dispute about presence

Challenge to procedure.requires: an alleged breach in obtaining evidence
Challenge to procedure.provides: an application to exclude material, no engagement with the facts

Guilty plea entered.provides: no trial of the facts, sentencing only

Full jury trial.requires: a not guilty plea and a listed court
Full jury trial.provides: contested evidence heard, a verdict by jury

Pre-trial admissibility hearing.provides: a ruling on admissibility, no verdict of any kind

Sentencing hearing.requires: a conviction or a plea already entered
Sentencing hearing.provides: mitigation heard, no finding of guilt left to make

Appeal against conviction.requires: a concluded trial and an arguable ground
Appeal against conviction.provides: review of the record, no fresh jury empanelled

Conviction on all counts.requires: a tribunal satisfied to the criminal standard
Conviction on all counts.provides: a finding of guilt, a sentence to follow

Acquittal.provides: no conviction recorded, no retrial on the same facts

Prosecution offers no evidence.requires: a case that cannot be sustained
Prosecution offers no evidence.provides: proceedings discontinued, no adjudication on the merits

Retrial ordered.requires: a conviction quashed with a direction
Retrial ordered.provides: the matter heard again, no final determination yet

EVIDENCE AVAILABLE|CASE OUTCOME.requires: a tribunal satisfied to the criminal standard
EVIDENCE AVAILABLE|CASE OUTCOME.blocked_by: no material to put before a court

DEFENCE POSITION|PROCEDURAL POSTURE.requires: no finding of guilt left to make

DEFENCE POSITION|CASE OUTCOME.requires: a case that cannot be sustained

PROCEDURAL POSTURE|CASE OUTCOME.blocked_by: no finding of guilt left to make
